findings.anchor: The extension relation on A^* is a partial order but not a linear order
findings.evidence: Empty alphabet gives the single empty sequence; singleton alphabet orders sequences by length. Both prefix orders are linear. Two distinct letters provide the stated incomparable-word example.
findings.remedy: Qualify nonlinearity by at least two alphabet elements; retain the unconditional partial-order claim and disclose the qualification.

findings.anchor: Every A subset Nat^* which is closed under sqsubseteq is a subtree
findings.evidence: The empty subset is prefix-closed but has no least root, required by the source tree definition. Any nonempty prefix-closed subset contains the empty sequence as its root.
findings.remedy: Add nonempty and a visible editorial note. Do not change prefix closure into closure under arbitrary extensions.
findings.confidence: high: explicit empty-set counterexample and root condition
